title: Wire ChatGPT-OAuth as a picker provider
goal: Extend the picker provider path so a run configured for the existing ChatGPT OAuth backend can request structured picker decisions through the already-governed OAuth streaming JSON helper instead of silently skipping non-Anthropic providers.
scope: Add a provider branch in the picker decision path that routes ChatGPT-OAuth configured runs through the existing `send_chatgpt_backend_streaming_json_request` helper with the same picker schema and safety prompt boundaries. Preserve Anthropic behavior and keep all approval, scope, runtime binding, and safety gates unchanged.
generation_reason: Operator added TASK_QUEUE.md item #386 for ChatGPT-OAuth picker provider work during the UI i18n follow-up. This package backfills the missing repo-backed task file required by backlog validation.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Picker provider routing only. Do not change runner behavior, approval gates, scope gates, finding schema, or prompt foundations beyond the minimal provider branch required.

success_criteria: Metric: ChatGPT-OAuth configured picker calls no longer return None solely because the provider is non-Anthropic.
Metric: Anthropic picker behavior remains unchanged.
Metric: structured picker JSON is parsed through the existing ChatGPT OAuth helper path.
Tests cover Claude path preservation and ChatGPT-OAuth picker branch behavior.
No approval, scope, runner, capability pack, or finding schema behavior changes.
must_not_touch: Capability pack registry / validation / approval / runtime binding flows

acceptance_criteria: A fixture or mocked provider test proves the ChatGPT-OAuth branch is called for a ChatGPT-OAuth configured picker run.
A regression test proves Anthropic picker calls still use the existing path.
Documentation records that this only enables the picker provider path; it does not prove ChatGPT makes better choices.

before_promotion: NEXT_TASK.md must contain this task as the single active task.
ANTI_DRIFT.md and SESSION_PROMPT.md must be loaded.
after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with validation results and provider-path evidence.
Promote the next queued package into NEXT_TASK.md.

out_of_scope: Claiming ChatGPT-OAuth is better without the follow-up A/B harness
